main.description: Replace the roles that may read a space, written into its community.opensocial.access record. Requires service-auth. Requires the `space.configure` action.

space.description: URI of the space to update.

roles.description: Record keys of the community.opensocial.role records that may read the space, written into its community.opensocial.access record.

errors.name: InvalidSpace
errors.description: The provided space URI is not a valid open social space.
